arStrings.szText: "Someone named Marcellus is using Morlu as pit fighters."
I've met the man—one of Akarat's favorites. Something off about him. His smile is a little too wide, and it never reaches his eyes.
A holy man running a pit fight is no great shock, I've seen worse down here, but bringing Morlu into the city? I can hardly believe it.
Arresting Marcellus isn't enough. He has a loyal circle, and we need a way in. I may have an idea. Meet me in the Agora, if you’ve still got a taste for this fight.
